<a id="model-10"></a>

## AuditWebhookDeliveryAttempt

```yaml
description: Redacted attempt metadata; payloads, credentials, signatures, headers, bodies, and raw errors are omitted.
properties:
    attempt:
        minimum: 1
        type: integer
    completed_at:
        format: date-time
        type: string
    created_at:
        format: date-time
        type: string
    delivery_id:
        type: integer
    event_id:
        maxLength: 128
        minLength: 16
        type: string
    http_status:
        type: integer
    id:
        type: integer
    key_id:
        pattern: ^swhkid_[-_A-Za-z0-9]+$
        type: string
    outcome:
        enum:
            - started
            - succeeded
            - retrying
            - failed
        type: string
    reason:
        enum:
            - network_error
            - timeout
            - http_4xx
            - http_5xx
            - invalid_response
            - no_key
            - signing_failure
            - configuration_error
            - delivery_failed
        type: string
    signed_at:
        format: date-time
        type: string
required:
    - id
    - delivery_id
    - event_id
    - attempt
    - key_id
    - signed_at
    - outcome
    - created_at
type: object
```

## ExecutionPreflightPlan

```yaml
properties:
    actor_id:
        type: integer
    commands:
        description: Value-free command shapes; argument and input values are omitted.
        items:
            type: object
        maxItems: 128
        type: array
    contract_version:
        enum:
            - 1
        type: integer
    definition:
        properties:
            fingerprint:
                type: string
            id:
                type: integer
            kind:
                type: string
            name:
                type: string
            revision:
                type: string
        type: object
    expires_at:
        format: date-time
        type: string
    findings:
        items:
            properties:
                code:
                    type: string
                message:
                    type: string
                severity:
                    enum:
                        - info
                        - warning
                        - denial
                    type: string
            type: object
        maxItems: 128
        type: array
    fingerprint:
        type: string
    inputs:
        items:
            properties:
                name:
                    type: string
                present:
                    type: boolean
                sensitive:
                    type: boolean
                source:
                    type: string
                type:
                    type: string
            type: object
        maxItems: 128
        type: array
    intent:
        enum:
            - task
            - workflow
        type: string
    placements:
        description: Provisional runner selections with at most 100 redacted candidates each.
        items:
            type: object
        maxItems: 128
        type: array
    project_id:
        type: integer
    references:
        items:
            properties:
                binding_target:
                    type: string
                id:
                    type: integer
                kind:
                    type: string
                name:
                    type: string
                reason:
                    type: string
                visible:
                    type: boolean
            type: object
        maxItems: 256
        type: array
    review_token:
        description: Opaque short-lived review binding; it is not execution authority.
        type: string
    template_id:
        type: integer
    workflow_id:
        type: integer
required:
    - contract_version
    - intent
    - project_id
    - actor_id
    - definition
    - fingerprint
    - expires_at
type: object
```

<a id="model-35"></a>

## GlobalCredentialResolutionSnapshot

```yaml
description: Value-free provenance for one execution-time credential resolution attempt.
properties:
    actor_id:
        description: Zero identifies an actorless task that was denied before dispatch.
        type: integer
    credential_id:
        type: integer
    credential_version:
        type: integer
    dispatch_generation:
        minimum: 0
        type: integer
    grant_id:
        type: integer
    occurred_at:
        format: date-time
        type: string
    outcome:
        enum:
            - allowed
            - denied
            - failure
        type: string
    project_id:
        type: integer
    provider_version:
        type: integer
    reason:
        enum:
            - allowed
            - actor_required
            - task_permission_denied
            - consume_permission_denied
            - capability_unavailable
            - credential_unavailable
            - grant_unavailable
            - provider_unavailable
            - audit_unavailable
            - injection_failed
        type: string
    runner_id:
        type: integer
    target:
        maxLength: 64
        type: string
    task_id:
        type: integer
```

```yaml
properties:
```

```yaml
        example: Test
        type: string
        x-nullable: true
    always_ssh_keys:
        description: |
            Additional SSH key references and their exact hosts. On templates and tasks, null inherits the parent selection and an empty array explicitly replaces it. Project always_ssh_keys are added in either case. Task overrides are restricted to users who can manage project resources and rejected for cross-project execution. Key IDs must identify project-owned SSH credentials. The complete encoded selection is bounded to 64 KiB. New projects accept only null or empty lists; assign bindings after creating their SSH credentials. Host lists are optional below five distinct task-agent identities, counting Repository and Inventory keys; runtime host routing is required from five. Explicit host lists apply at every size. This configures client selection, not an enforcement boundary against task-controlled SSH clients.
        example: []
        items:
            $ref: '#/definitions/TaskSSHKeyBinding'
        maxItems: 64
        type: array
        x-nullable: true
    created:

    default_ssh_keys:

Project always_ssh_keys are added in either case. Task overrides are restricted to users who can manage project resources and rejected for cross-project execution. Key IDs must identify project-owned SSH credentials. The complete encoded selection is bounded to 64 KiB. New projects accept only null or empty lists; assign bindings after creating their SSH credentials. Host lists are optional below five distinct task-agent identities, counting Repository and Inventory keys; runtime host routing is required from five. Explicit host lists apply at every size. This configures client selection, not an enforcement boundary against task-controlled SSH clients.
        example: []
        items:
            $ref: '#/definitions/TaskSSHKeyBinding'

        type: array
        x-nullable: true
```
